tools.name: build_utm_link
tools.description: Add UTM parameters to a URL for Google Analytics 4 campaign tracking and get back the tagged link and the GA4 channel its visits will count under. Follows the UTM builder at postfa.st/tools/utm-builder: values are lowercased and spaces become hyphens. For a social platform source such as linkedin or tiktok, or newsletter, medium can be left out.

url.description: The page the link opens, starting with https:// or http://.

source.description: Where the click comes from, e.g. linkedin, instagram, newsletter.

medium.description: Channel type, e.g. social, paid_social, email, cpc. Can be left out when source is a social platform or newsletter; the builder's preset fills it.

term.description: Paid search keyword or test variant.

content.description: Tells links in one campaign apart, e.g. reel or bio-link.

tools.name: get_media_specs
tools.description: Get the recommended dimensions, aspect ratios, maximum file size, formats and length limits for images or video in one placement on a social platform, such as Instagram Reels or a YouTube thumbnail, from the size guides on postfa.st/sizes. Omit placement to list a platform's placements with their main size.

placement.description: Where the media appears, e.g. reels, stories, feed, cover. Omit it to list the placements the platform has.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get PostFast's plan prices in EUR for both monthly and yearly billing, with each plan's social account, user and workspace limits, as published on postfa.st/pricing. Pass plan for that plan's full limits and features. get_signup_link returns the link that starts a trial on a plan.

plan.description: One plan to describe in full. Omit it to compare every plan.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Get the link that starts a PostFast free trial, for the person to open. It returns a URL only; the account is created when the person completes signup on app.postfa.st. get_pricing has the plans and prices.

plan.description: The plan the person wants. It is recorded with the signup; the plan itself is chosen during onboarding in the app.

tools.name: search_api_docs
tools.description: Search the PostFast REST API reference (postfa.st/docs) and the per-platform API guides (postfa.st/api-guides). Returns matching pages, most relevant first, each with a one-line summary; API reference results also have rate limits and a markdownUrl with the whole page as Markdown.

query.description: What to find, e.g. "upload a video", "schedule Instagram reels", "reply to comments" or "create posts".

limit.description: Most results to return. Defaults to 5.
